title: Attest merges on the remote, re-verify acceptance on main, and audit owed merges
goal: Item 4-5: auto-merge records refs/merged/<id> after a successful merge; a main-only job re-runs the task's cargo acceptance on the merged tree and records refs/verified/<id>; susi tasks audit reconciles close receipts, abandonments and merge attestations against origin/main per agent, and the sync board shows owed merges swarm-wide.
